notes: net::mail: Addresses/lists/groups, Go address formatting, RFC 2047 names with charset hook, lenient message headers and Go date layouts (dates are time::Time parsed with Go's layouts); text is UTF-8 only

Address.String.note: the Display impl gives Go's Address.String formatting; checked by tools/mail_check.py

Header.Get.note: returns None where Go returns "" for an absent or empty field

ParseAddress.note: Names, addresses, header keys and values and decoded encoded words are String, so non-UTF-8 bytes are reported as errors; Go keeps them in strings.

ParseAddressList.note: Names, addresses, header keys and values and decoded encoded words are String, so non-UTF-8 bytes are reported as errors; Go keeps them in strings.

ParseDate.note: Returns time::Time parsed with Go's own layouts through time::parse, so every date Go accepts is held (year 0, offsets of 24 hours or more).

ReadMessage.note: Names, addresses, header keys and values and decoded encoded words are String, so non-UTF-8 bytes are reported as errors; Go keeps them in strings.
